label: The unrestricted measure doctrine fails: not everything that seems so to…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: What the restricted measure doctrine concedes (Theaetetus 171e-172a), read narrowly as the denial of the doctrine outside its domain, defeats the unrestricted doctrine, which would give it there (the restriction of a norm on (agent, content) pairs). No particular case of seeming without truth-for is assumed. The restricted and the unrestricted doctrine cannot both be held with the concession.
